budget.order: fixtures in listed order; return,stationary,novel; v05 arms then memory arms in listed order; sequential worker per branch

decision.Fw: Separate assembly/readout acquisition from weights/delays. Fw prediction success does not prove field-learning benefit.
decision.memory_baselines: Report H/R return and novel comparisons; no general superiority gate or stationary comparator claim.

novel.ceiling_outcome: acquisition_inconclusive; overall supported gate cannot pass; never alter inputs or thresholds after outcomes

decision.overall: Primary return AND secondary return AND stationary preservation AND informative novel acquisition/preservation for each fixture. Missing/incomplete/invalid rows cannot pass.
decision.scope: Each fixture separately; both must meet gates. No significance/population claim.

secondary_return.residual_gain_confound: Single analytic steady-state control does not remove all finite-horizon/history-dependent gain explanations.

input_contract.occurrence_id: occ-{64+index:06d}; same IDs across independent suffix branches, no condition/seed/target encoding

rng.family: Python random.Random seeded by int(SHA256(UTF-8 key).hexdigest(),16)
rng.novel_order: Construct [0]*8+[1]*8 for each block independently, then rng.shuffle once. No random target/count draws. Mapping0->ACF/outcome0 and1->CAF/outcome1 fixed.
rng.pairing: Every arm receives identical bytes for its fixture/condition. Distractor RNG is outcome-independent, shared across arms; no target-based reseeding or branching.

intervention_boundary.L_semantics: Each apply starts with e_old multiplied by0; for currently coactive plastic edges with nonzero signed current STDP sum delta, e_new=delta and weight=clip(weight+0.001*reward_trace*delta). Exactly one apply per occurrence. No separate eligibility clearing, episode reset or state reset.
intervention_boundary.accounting: Record pre-apply eligibility, decayed carry, signed current delta, unclipped proposal, clipped actual signed/absolute weight change, update eligibility, and clipping flags without extra apply calls.
intervention_boundary.baseline_semantics: C/G: e_new=0.9*e_old+delta only on currently eligible nonzero-delta edges; no current pre/post or delta=0 means no weight write. All stored traces still decay per apply.
intervention_boundary.delay_boundary: No delay writes in any v05 branch; compare complete delay maps to restored prefix after every occurrence. Conditional fixed-delay question, not equivalence to the live-delay default full model.
intervention_boundary.homeostasis: Remains live; do not set learn_field=False. No claim of isolated weight trajectories independent of homeostasis.
intervention_boundary.when: After one native restoration per branch and before first suffix process_episode; replace only specified plasticity-config fields and corresponding brain learning flags, preserving all other state.

metrics.bin_convention: left-closed right-open, finalbin includes1; empty bins null; raw count,mean probability,outcome fraction only; no calibration fit
metrics.brier: Mean (p1-outcome)^2 on every allocated row, including abstention; use Python math.fsum of double-precision row losses divided by exact row count; compare unrounded values.
metrics.probability: Published wrapper Laplace count adapter unchanged, separate from native confidence.

Freeze execution runner, interpreter/dependencies, counters, deadlines/output enforcement and output-root absence

Obtain explicit approval of exact reviewed execution freeze; this preparation is not that approval

public_prefix_source.status: exposed development fixtures, not independent training replicates or confirmatory heldout data

resources.execution_mode: future CPU-only sequential subprocess per branch; not implemented/enforced by this preparation
resources.failure: Stop admitting work on any resource/measurement/integrity failure, preserve partial rows and method intents/completions; no retry; no clean rerun. Threshold is admission/checkpoint, not instantaneous filesystem quota.
resources.network: offline runtime; required enforcement and its actual layer must be declared/tested before execution.
resources.output_safety: fresh absent output disjoint from original archive and snapshots; bounded pipe draining, projected writes before admission, exact truncation/overshoot accounting, capped failure metadata only inside reserve.
resources.rss: Measure driver and each worker peakRSS separately; address-space limit is not RSS measurement.
resources.terminal_metadata_arithmetic: 26*131072+524288=3932160 <=4194304 reserve; reserve is WITHIN256MiB, never additive
